column1: # The range each numeric Scoring-decision setting accepts, read from the code that refuses values (min/max empty = no limit enforced).
# enforced_by names the validator: prereg_admin = python/prereg_admin.py validate_value; score_*.py = the scorer's own check. test/test_setting_ranges.py runs them against this table.

column10: note
How many times a failed tool run is repeated. No upper limit is enforced.
Whole seconds per tool per isolate; 0 is refused. Leave empty (the confirmed default) for no time limit.
Independent clusters a species needs before it is averaged into the headline.
Smallest size (bases) at which a large non-chromosomal replicon counts as a chromid.
Size (bases) from which a plasmid is called large.
Shortest alignment (bases) that counts; the scorers refuse 0.
Minimum mapping quality; the scorers refuse a negative value and enforce no upper limit (minimap2 itself reports 0 to 60).
Shortest contig (bases) that is labelled and scored.
Samples a scorecard row needs before it is shown.
Bases either side of a resistance-gene copy used as its flank context.
Highest reference-evidence tier allowed in the headline analysis.
Independent clusters the headline references must come from.
A fraction: 0.90 means 90% identity. The scorers refuse values outside 0 to 1.
A fraction of the query that must align: 0.20 means 20%. The scorers refuse values outside 0 to 1.
A fraction above 0 and up to 1 (0.90 means 90% of the plasmid recovered). The scorers refuse 0 and anything above 1.
A fraction (0.95 means 95%): precision and recall both at least this make a bin perfect. No upper limit is enforced, but a value above 1 can never be met.
A fraction of a plasmid another bin must hold for it to count as fragmented. No upper limit is enforced.
A best-bin recall below this fraction counts the plasmid as missed. No upper limit is enforced.
A fraction: identity a contig needs to be labelled. No upper limit is enforced.
A fraction of the contig that must align to be labelled. No upper limit is enforced.
A fraction: identity between the two halves of a candidate dimer. No upper limit is enforced.
A fraction of each half that must align for a dimer call. No upper limit is enforced.
How close to the best score still counts as near optimal. No upper limit is enforced.
Smallest gap to the best possible choice that is reported. No upper limit is enforced.
Regret above which a recommendation counts as a failure. No upper limit is enforced.
Lowest expected score for which a method is still recommended. No upper limit is enforced.
Smallest difference between tools that is called meaningful. No upper limit is enforced.
Share of the headline one study may hold before it is flagged as dominant. No upper limit is enforced.
1 scores the monomer; 0 only flags a dimer. Only 0 and 1 are accepted.
1 lets the headline fall back when the primary analysis is unavailable. Only 0 and 1 are accepted.
